summary: Four more children died in the last 24 hours, with over 1,200 new cases of suspected or confirmed measles reported by the DGHS.

caption:
Over 1,000 deaths recorded as a measles outbreak sweeps through Bangladesh. 4 more children died in just 24 hours.

Four people died from measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) control room on Sunday.

In the same period, 1,236 new patients were identified with suspected or confirmed measles symptoms.

From March 15 to September 20, a total of 179,814 people have shown measles symptoms, with 20,562 cases being confirmed.

The death toll from measles symptoms has reached 956 children since March 15, while 101 deaths have been attributed to confirmed measles cases during this period.

A total of 1,057 deaths have been recorded since the outbreak began, including those with suspected symptoms and confirmed cases.

Regarding hospitalizations, 158,589 people were admitted to hospitals with measles symptoms between March 15 and September 20, and 152,255 have since been discharged.

headline_marked: iPhone motive in [[13-year-old boy killed]] in Cumilla; 3 arrested
headline: iPhone motive in 13-year-old boy killed in Cumilla; 3 arrested
summary: Police arrested three suspects, including two teenagers, after a boy was allegedly killed during an attempted iPhone snatching in the Sananda area.
details: A 13-year-old boy, Ishiat Shahriar Opratim, was allegedly killed in Cumilla's Sananda area between 5:00 pm and 6:00 pm last Friday.
Cumilla Superintendent of Police Md Anisuzzaman stated that the suspects attempted to snatch Opratim's iPhone, leading to a scuffle.
During the fight, a 19-year-old suspect, Saiful Islam Tuhin, allegedly struck Opratim on the head with a stick, and two other teenage boys also hit him.
After confirming the boy's death, Tuhin allegedly took the phone and fled the scene with the others.
Police identified Tuhin through CCTV footage and detained him, who then confessed to the killing and implicated the other two arrested suspects.
The arrested include Tuhin (19) and two 15-year-olds. Another youth, Md Siam (19), has been detained for verification of his involvement.
Investigators found an 'age-disparate friendship' between Opratim and the accused, though none of them were classmates.
Police noted that the accused were either dropouts or irregular students from different educational institutions.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy was killed in Cumilla over an iPhone. Three suspects, including two teenagers, have been arrested.

A 13-year-old boy, Ishiat Shahriar Opratim, was allegedly killed in Cumilla's Sananda area between 5:00 pm and 6:00 pm last Friday.

Cumilla Superintendent of Police Md Anisuzzaman stated that the suspects attempted to snatch Opratim's iPhone, leading to a scuffle.

During the fight, a 19-year-old suspect, Saiful Islam Tuhin, allegedly struck Opratim on the head with a stick, and two other teenage boys also hit him.

After confirming the boy's death, Tuhin allegedly took the phone and fled the scene with the others.

Police identified Tuhin through CCTV footage and detained him, who then confessed to the killing and implicated the other two arrested suspects.

The arrested include Tuhin (19) and two 15-year-olds. Another youth, Md Siam (19), has been detained for verification of his involvement.

Investigators found an 'age-disparate friendship' between Opratim and the accused, though none of them were classmates.

Police noted that the accused were either dropouts or irregular students from different educational institutions.
